speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are presenting with gait and limb ataxia; to begin my assessment, have you noticed any numbness, weakness, or double vision accompanying these symptoms? Additionally, can you describe any specific events, such as falls or head trauma, that might be related?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: The patient confirms difficulty walking and clumsiness, particularly on the right side, but denies numbness, weakness, or double vision so far. Have you experienced any recent head trauma, new medications, or changes in your balance that started suddenly?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

I need to confirm the exact duration of your Crohn's disease and when you started natalizumab to assess your risk window. REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain_with_contrast. REQUEST IMAGES.
